text: (Un)Commentary is the second and major-label debut studio album by American singer-songwriter Alec Benjamin, released on April 15, 2022, via Elektra Records. The album yielded five singles, with "Devil Doesn't Bargain" being the only one to chart. Benjamin launched an international tour in 2022 to promote the album. Matthew Dwyer of PopMatters noted that Benjamin's passion for contemplation is evident in his music, as he transforms thought experiments into engaging parables enhanced by polished studio production and acoustic instrumentation. Dwyer also praised the album's autobiographical storytelling as sharp and highlighted Benjamin's eye for detail and distinctive narrative approach, stating that while such qualities are rare in pop today, they indicate he will be shaping trends for years to come.
